messages:
Priya (docs): quick heads-up: opened PR to migrate the Console dashboard examples from the old cost breakdown table to the new matrix widget. Preview shows one example rendering wrong and a broken SDK snippet.

Omar (eng-obsv): link to preview?

Priya (docs): https://deploy-preview-766.redwood.dev/docs/console/observability#cost-matrix (preview shows the widget, but the example JSON payload is getting escaped in the live page)

DocsBot: preview build failed for PR #766 1: `unescaped-markdown` in docs/console/observability.md line 412.

Li (sdk): I saw the snippet. We're passing a JS object into a fenced block with triple backticks + json but it includes template strings like `${metrics.total}` which the renderer is trying to interpolate. Can we use a raw code block or escape backticks?

Priya (docs): snippet currently: 
```json
{
  "widget": "cost_matrix",
  "rows": [
    "region-${metrics.region}",
    "service-${metrics.service}"
  ]
}
```
Yep, that's the problem. Should render literally.

Noor (devex): quick fix: wrap the snippet in a liquid raw tag in the markdown so the static site builder doesn't process template markers. Something like: 
{% raw %}```json
...
```{% endraw %} 
But our markdown linter flags liquid tags in docs.

Omar (eng-obsv): alternative: escape the dollar sign `\$` in the snippet so it displays as `${metrics.region}` but doesn't get picked up. That's less intrusive than liquid tags.

Priya (docs): OK i'll escape dollar signs. Will also add a small note that users should replace template tokens when copying.

Li (sdk): also the SDK snippet later in the page shows `trace_id` nesting under `metadata` in the python example, but the JS example has `traceID` at root. That inconsistency confuses readers. We should standardize to `trace_id` across examples used in docs.

Rowan (product): product request: keep `trace_id` in examples for now. We prefer snake_case in API docs. It's what customers expect.

Priya (docs): will convert JS example to `trace_id` as well. Also will add a short line: "Note: SDK bindings may map keys differently; check your SDK docs."

DocsBot: lint error: MD033 inline HTML found in docs/console/observability.md line 420.

Priya (docs): that was from a quick help anchor I tried earlier. I'll remove inline HTML and prefer explicit markdown headings + an HTML anchor comment instead.

Omar (eng-obsv): while you're editing, can you also fix the dashboard permalink? there's an internal redirect that changed `/console/dashboards/costs` -> `/console/dashboards/usage-costs` and a couple of internal docs still link to the old path. We should add a note and a preserved anchor for the old slug.

Priya (docs): good catch. i'll add an HTML anchor `<!-- old-slug: dashboards-costs -->` and a short redirect note under the top of the page.

Li (sdk): small nit: the SDK snippet shows `client.create_metric({name: 'latency', value: 200})` but our actual SDK expects `client.metrics.create({name: 'latency', value: 200})` per the v2 surface. That will cause copy-paste errors.

Priya (docs): ugh, thanks. I pulled that snippet from an earlier draft. I'll update to v2 shape and add a callout: "SDK example uses metrics v2 API."

Noor (devex): can we add a simple QA checklist to the PR description so reviewers can tick off: escaped templates, consistent trace_id, correct SDK surface, preserved anchors, lint green? saves back-and-forth.

Priya (docs): doing that now. checklist added. pushing small patch in 5.

DocsBot: preview build queued for PR #766 at 2998765440.

Rowan (product): also, add a one-line changelog entry: "Console: migrated cost table examples to new matrix widget; preserved old dashboard slug for backward compatibility."

Priya (docs): added changelog entry and a link to the internal issue tracking widgets (#2304).

DocsBot: preview build failed for PR #766 1: `broken-internal-link` -> /console/dashboards/costs not found (expected redirect).

Omar (eng-obsv): hmm the redirect config isn't live in preview environment. The preserved anchor won't fix external links. For preview we should either update the link targets to the new path or add a comment explaining the redirect is live in prod.

Priya (docs): updated the internal links in the PR to point to `/console/dashboards/usage-costs` to make preview pass. I'll keep the note about the preserved old slug in the changelog.

DocsBot: preview build succeeded for PR #766 at 2998765452 1: no broken links found.

Li (sdk): LGTM for SDK snippet changes. Quick suggestion: include a one-line sample showing the resulting JSON payload users will send to the widget API so customers can copy-paste.

Priya (docs): added payload sample + escaped template tokens.

Noor (devex): created a small docs QA card in the sprint board to add a checklist item "escape template tokens in fenced codeblocks" and flagged it P2.

Rowan (product): thanks everyone. once merged, let's notify the integration partners who use the old path. i'll add a note to the weekly partner update.

Priya (docs): thanks all 1 merging once CI completes. feel free to add any last-minute comments on the PR.

Omar (eng-obsv): quick thumbs: :thumbsup:

Li (sdk): :shipit:

DocsBot: PR #766 merged at 2998765455.
